args.title: Clarify local setup instructions for AWS credentials
args.body:
File: README.md

Improve the documentation to better explain how users should handle AWS credentials in a local setup. Include steps to avoid misunderstandings around placeholder values and real credentials, ensuring that local staging environments are set up correctly without attempting to use credentials that aren't available.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The README lacks detailed instructions on how to handle AWS credentials in a local testing setup. It's recommended to clarify the usage of placeholder credentials versus real ones to prevent errors such as "InvalidAccessKeyId" during uploads.
